summary: This change is a clean move of the Close and land row from run/mod.rs into a new run/close.rs, and it passes. I compared the old mod.rs with the new close.rs (`git diff --numstat HEAD~1:…/mod.rs HEAD:…/close.rs`): only 14 lines in close.rs do not appear in the old mod.rs. Reading close.rs accounts for all of them: the two-line module comment, `use super::*;`, and the two method signatures (`close_dispatched`, `retry_landing`) that rustfmt rewrapped once `pub(super)` was added. mod.rs gains only `mod close;` and `pub use close::{build_text, closing_subject};`, and no test line changes. The caller claims in the CHANGELOG match a search of crates/ and xtask/. Athena's recorded fmt, clippy and test runs passed. I ran the landing tests (69 in athena-core) and the CLI trailer_stop tests that drive retry_landing (4); all passed. There are two minor gaps. Section 5 of the design doc asks the report to record the test count and, for each moved name, the file count before and after. The CHANGELOG lists the callers but gives neither count, and it does not name the rewrapped signature lines.
